results.reason: lifecycle.Event has no rate-limit field, and the fixture format cannot carry the statusline snapshot holding the counters — for any front end. Unlike cost and tokens, which are derived from transcript counts, quota is a subscription counter taken from the agent and never reconstructed by us. Making it observable needs a recordable lifecycle event with rate-limit fields, or a live-metrics probe spec the format does not have. Verified against core/domain/lifecycle/event.go; the cited note carries the commands.
